UNSC non-permanent seat: India’s candidature receives unanimous endorsement by Asia-Pacific group

By:The Hindu - 26 June,2019

Short Detail

India has won the unanimous support of all countries in the 55-member Asia-Pacific Group at the United Nations in support of its bid for a non-permanent seat at the UN Security Council (UNSC) for a two-year term in 2021-22.

Syed Akbaruddin. Source:Jammu Links News

U.K. Sinha-led RBI panel suggests Rs. 5,000 crore stressed asset fund for MSMEs

By:Livemint - 26 June,2019

Short Detail

A Reserve Bank of India (RBI) committee has suggested a Rs. 5,000 crore stressed asset fund for domestic micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in a relief to small businesses hurt by demonetization, the goods and services tax and an ongoing liquidity crunch.

The centre also passed

1. FOF(Fund of Funds) : A Rs 10,000 crore Inorder to support Venture Capitalists or PE (private equity) investing in the MSME sector.

2. SIDBI’s role: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) will be responsible for MSME's.

3. Distressed asset fund: A Rs.5000 Cr fund operates on the lines of the Textile Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS).

Dr Biju's Malayalam film 'Veyil Marangal’ wins award at Shanghai Film Festival

By:The News Minute - 25 June,2019

Short Detail

In the 22nd Shanghai International Film Festival, Director Bijukumar Damodaran has received the Outstanding Artistic Achievement Award for the film, Veyil Marangal (Trees Under the Sun),thus becoming the first Indian film to win a major award at the festival.

It is Dr. Biju’s second time at the fest, after featuring his film ‘Aakasathinte Niram'(Colour of Sky) in 2012 at Shanghai.

Odisha CM unveils Flood Hazard Atlas

By:Business Standard - 23 June,2019(IST)

Short Detail

Odisha Chief Minister,Naveen Patnaik at the State Level Natural Calamity Committee meeting unveiled a Flood Hazard Atlas for better preparedness.

Flood Hazard Atlas of Odisha. Source:The Hindu

The atlas prepared by National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Hyderabad and Odisha State Disaster Management Authority (OSDMA), will help management of the flood in the state as "Odisha is a flood prone state.

The flood hazard atlas has been made after ascertaining data on flood between 2000 and 2018, around 1.4 Million acres of agriculture is effected by flood each year in Odisha.

From Japan, a museum of peace built on memories of WWII

By:The Hindu - 22 June,2019

Short Detail

Japan gifted Imphal Peace Museum to Manipur to mark the 75th anniversary of the Battle of Imphal, one of the fiercest battles of the Second World War, at Maibam Lokpa Ching popularly known as Red Hill (about 20 km southwest of Imphal).

Imphal Peace Museum. Source:nippon-foundation.or.jp

The main attraction of the museum is a framed calligraphy by Prime Minister Shinzo Abe of Japan with the word ‘Peace’ or ‘Heiwa’ in Japanese which means an unfaltering hope for a peaceful future.
